title: 01 / Task and permitted context
detail: The engineer supplies the task; delivery systems supply approved source material.

title: 02 / Generate a candidate
detail: The context service passes permitted, versioned evidence to the runtime.

title: 03 / Enforce authority
detail: The runtime requests an action; the gateway checks identity, resource scope and approval.

title: 04 / Verify generated work
detail: An allowed request reaches independent sandbox and deterministic checks.

title: 05 / Evaluate AI applications · parallel branch
detail: AI application versions enter evaluation. This branch is separate from generated-test execution.

title: 06 / Independent release decision
detail: The relevant checks or evaluation results reach the release owner; the generator cannot approve itself.

title: 07 / Retain execution and decision evidence
detail: Run traces and release decisions join the evidence store. Trace collection also occurs during execution.

title: 08 / Curate regression cases
detail: Reviewed failures and expectations become versioned cases with appropriate data controls.

title: 09 / Challenge the next release · feedback loop
detail: The curated corpus supplies cases for future evaluations, closing the learning loop.
